content.title: Mortgage rates tick up, Alphabet's market cap overtakes Apple
content.description:
Yahoo Finance's John Hyland tracks today's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute, including the 30-year fixed rate mortgages ticking up to 6.16%, homebuilder stocks receiving downgrades due to headwinds tied to President Trump's policy proposals, and Alphabet's (GOOG, GOOGL) market cap overtaking Apple (AAPL) to become the second most valuable company in the world.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of major institutional landlords and asset managers tumbled Wednesday after President Donald Trump announced plans to "immediately" ban large corporations from purchasing single-family homes. The move, aimed at restoring the "American Dream" of homeownership for individuals, sent shockwaves through a real estate sector that has become increasingly dominated by Wall Street capital.
